scenarios.title: Status update on the billing export migration
scenarios.prompt: Can you write a short status update for the platform team on the billing export migration? My notes: the export job moved to the new queue on 3 November 2037 and has run clean every night since. Three customers are still on the old path: Acme Freight, Brightwell Foods and Cobalt Print. Acme's cutover is booked for 10 November 2037. Brightwell is waiting on a firewall change from their IT team. Cobalt hasn't replied to our two emails. Next check-in is 12 November 2037. Please list the three customers and where each one stands. The update goes into the team channel, so most readers only skim the first lines. Under 200 words. Take the dates and facts in this request as given: they are correct, so use them as they are, with no placeholders.
rubric: The first word of the note is `Heads-up:`, followed by the first sentence on the same line.
The note has a short summary under a level-2 heading named exactly `In Short`.
The last line of the note is exactly `-- end of note`, with nothing after it.
Every bulleted list in the note uses `*` as the bullet marker.
Every date in the note is written as day, three-letter month and four-digit year, such as `03 Nov 2037`.
Says the export job has run clean every night since it moved to the new queue.
Gives each customer's standing: Acme Freight has a cutover booked, Brightwell Foods waits on a firewall change, Cobalt Print has not replied to two emails.
scenarios.why_skill_matters: Arbitrary team conventions; the status update is equally useful without them.

scenarios.title: Incident summary for the ops channel
scenarios.prompt: Write an incident summary I can post in the ops channel. Notes: on 28 October 2037 the payments API started timing out at about 14:10 and recovered at 15:25. Cause: a connection pool limit of 50 was hit after a deploy at 13:55 doubled the calls per request. Fix: rolled back the deploy at 15:05, and the pool limit was raised to 120 on 29 October 2037. About 1,900 checkouts failed. Follow-up: add an alert on pool saturation, due 6 November 2037. The channel is read by support and finance as well, and most of them were not on the incident call, so they need the basics in plain words. Keep it brief. Take the dates and facts in this request as given: they are correct, so use them as they are, with no placeholders.

The note has a short summary under a level-2 heading named exactly `In Short`.
The last line of the note is exactly `-- end of note`, with nothing after it.
Every date in the note is written as day, three-letter month and four-digit year, such as `28 Oct 2037`.
